_note: Local-only test cohorts, uploaded on the local stack in project 'Nessie test cohorts'; the uids are that stack's (a fresh stack re-uploads scripts/pipeline_scenarios/make_test_cohorts.py's workbooks and re-records them). A story whose cohort has no uids is skipped by the runner.

human_exome.description: Human whole-exome with a named capture kit

tumour_normal.description: One patient: tumour and matched normal DNA

chip.description: ChIP-seq with an antibody and an input control

nonmodel_rnaseq.description: RNA-seq of a species with no reference bundle

cutandrun.description: CUT&Tag for two histone marks with an IgG control, paired-end

giab_hg001_vcf.description: NA12878 (GIAB HG001) whole-genome germline: two D.SEQ libraries, each with A.VCF children from a reingested sarek 3.10.0 run (haplotypecaller and deepvariant).

normal_bams.description: Two human blood-normal WGS libraries registered as aligned BAMs (D.SEQ DataType BAM), the shape of TCGA's GDC blood normals. Stand-ins from nf-core test-datasets (both are the same test individual on a small chr22 genome), for selection stories only.

tumour_normal_rna.description: One patient: tumour RNA-seq, tumour exome and matched blood exome, all linked to the patient (rnadnavar's input)
